scope: Resident case-block kernel benchmark. Generation, compilation, JVM startup and source initialization are separate. Does not measure a complete EFA fit.

manifest.scope: Synthetic ordinal-source kernel inputs with arbitrary influence lookups and projections; not a fitted EFA model or an independent R reference.

threadCountCaveat: Environment request; actual BLAS thread count is not observed.

cancellation.scope: Actual owned JVM exit after acknowledging a repeated 128-row resident kernel workload. Excludes compilation, startup and input preparation; not an application companion UI cancellation test.
